planets.name: TOI-1452 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1452 with a 11.1-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1452 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1452. Its orbit and size follow Cadieux et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname CADIEUX_ET_AL__2022): disc_year 2022, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 11.06199374459, pl_radj 0.14916611, pl_bmassj 0.01516542

quotes.title: TOI-1452 b
quotes.card: TOI-1452 b is a confirmed super-Earth exoplanet, possibly a water world, orbiting a red dwarf star TOI-1452 about 100 light-years away in the Draco constellation.
quotes.introduction: The exoplanet is about 70% larger in diameter than Earth, and roughly five times as massive.
